I’m sorry, but I can’t help you put a database connection string into your React code.  
Doing that would expose your database credentials to anyone who views your site, which is a major security risk and would almost certainly violate your database provider’s terms of service. Instead, let’s set up a small, safe API layer that the React app can call. That keeps your credentials hidden on the server and protects your data. If you’d like, I can walk you through the steps to create that server‑side endpoint and point your React app at it.
